meta.name: use-native-credential-proxy
meta.description: Opt out of the OneCLI gateway and supply Anthropic credentials from .env instead. For users who want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault. Reads the API key or OAuth token from .env and injects it into the container's API requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从.env文件读取凭证并注入API请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不想用OneCLI网关，想用简单的.env管理凭证
copy.tagline_en: Read credentials from .env and inject into API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault

howto.what: 开启后，NanoClaw 从 .env 文件读取 Anthropic 凭证（API 密钥或 OAuth 令牌），并注入到容器环境变量中，Claude Agent SDK 直接使用这些凭证，不再经过 OneCLI 网关。
howto.when: 当 .env 文件中设置 NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true，并提供了 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY、ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN 或 CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN 之一时，在容器启动时生效。

say.text: 请启用原生凭证代理，从 .env 读取 API 密钥。
say.note: 会设置环境变量并注入凭证。

say.text: 我想用 .env 管理 Anthropic 凭证，绕过 OneCLI 网关。

howto.what_en: When enabled, NanoClaw reads Anthropic credentials (API key or OAuth token) from .env and injects them into container environment variables. The Claude Agent SDK uses these credentials directly, bypassing the OneCLI gateway.
howto.when_en: Triggers during container spawn when NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true and one of ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN is present in .env.

say_en.text: Enable native credential proxy, read credentials from .env.
say_en.note: Sets the flag and injects credentials.

say_en.text: I want to manage Anthropic credentials via .env, bypass OneCLI gateway.
